title: Do You Really Need an Extra $20,000 for In‑Unit Laundry?

scenes.text: Myth: Adding in‑unit laundry justifies $20,000 extra.
scenes.label: Laundry = 20K

scenes.text: Truth: In‑unit laundry adds $1,200–$1,800 per year, not $20,000 upfront.
scenes.label: Laundry Cost $1.2–1.8K

scenes.text: Takeaway: Compare annual running costs to upfront price.
scenes.label: Run Costs vs Price

scenes.text: Follow for daily money habits that actually work.

description: Is a $20,000 in‑unit laundry worth it? The annual cost is far lower than the upfront price. Learn how to make smarter housing decisions. Follow for more money‑smart myths busted!
